classification: preregistered A/B risk-budget frontier audit; no factor changes and no return-maximizing selection
common_rule: After A/B allocation, apply the same 60d 15% volatility target with total exposure [0.2,1.0], monthly rebalance and 0.52% overlay turnover cost.

gates.D1: all five variants complete; current cap08 reproduces R312 full stats; all variants use finite returns

known_limitations: This is a post-R315 risk-budget adjustment, not independent alpha discovery.
All variants share the same history and underlying A/B legs.
R40 local snapshot and canonical data drift remain unresolved.
A passing variant would still be research/paper-review only.
question: R317 显示调整风险平价窗口和目标波动率不能改善年度持有体验。把更防守的 A 腿权重上限从 80% 提高到 90%/100%，或固定 A 权重，能否减少 2022/2023 负年，同时保留足够收益和回撤？
selection_rule: All variants judged by G1-G9. Among passers, choose the highest bootstrap positive rate, tie-break by bootstrap median. Do not select on raw full-period return. If none pass, keep current cap08 and record negative knowledge.
